name: lumina
description: Lumina — a locally-aware AI agent runtime with capability-aware routing and human-approved tool use

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix electron install
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix electron run build
scripts.package: npm run build && npm --prefix electron run package
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && npm --prefix electron run package:mac
scripts.package:win: npm run build && npm --prefix electron run package:win
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && npm --prefix electron run package:linux
